editorNote: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 alongside a more visual ChatGPT, and Anthropic answered with Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS; coverage pairs the two on price and capability, though the comparisons are mostly vendor and newsletter claims. Separately, OpenAI posted hundreds of math manuscripts from an internal model. Nothing is independently verified yet, so read the skeptics alongside it.
